verdict.rationale: Featurebase's own marketing claims a workflow builder ('Build workflows for SLAs, automatically extending trials, offering discounts'), which suggests user-defined automations, but it is a single thin marketing line with no documentation of event triggers, conditions, or available actions. Webhooks are an outbound building block for developers and the automatic shipped-request notifications are fixed behavior, so neither is credited as user-defined rules. Missing for 10: documented trigger/event catalog, rule/condition configuration, action types, first-party workflow docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Build workflows for SLAs, automatically extending trials, offering discounts, and much more.
